title: Bifrost Conformance Policy (governed conformance artifact)
description: Protocol-independent, governed declarative conformance config: the IAM-like policy artifact binding a governed equipment definition to a strictness dial, a set of conditional cross-member constraints, and the OPC-UA node bindings that address governed members. Language-neutral — any consumer can validate a policy document against this schema without depending on Bifrost code. Bifrost itself deserializes with a lenient mapper, so this schema is documentary.

equipmentRef.description: Registry-key id of the governed equipment definition this policy binds.

crossConstraints.description: Conditional cross-member bound rules (a small closed algebra).

nodeBindings.description: Bindings linking each governed member to its OPC-UA write/read nodes.

dial.description: Strictness dial: the mode plus, for recipe-mode, the active recipe ref/version + tolerance.

mode.description: Strictness mode: "envelope" (governed EURange only) or "recipe" (active recipe + tolerance).

activeRecipeRef.description: Registry-key id of the active recipe (recipe-mode only; null otherwise).

activeRecipeVersion.description: Version of the active recipe (recipe-mode only; null otherwise).

recipeTolerance.description: Allowed +/- tolerance around each recipe setpoint (recipe-mode only; null otherwise).

crossConstraint.description: One conditional-bound rule: if <ifMember> <ifOp> <ifValue> then require <thenMember> <thenOp> <thenValue>.

ifMember.description: Member name evaluated by the antecedent (condition).

thenMember.description: Member name required by the consequent (bound).

nodeBinding.description: Links a governed member to its OPC-UA nodes: the write/setpoint node matched against an incoming command, and the live instance node read for cross-member rules.

opcNodeId.description: OPC-UA write/setpoint node id matched against an incoming command (null for read-only siblings never commanded).

readNodeId.description: OPC-UA live instance node id whose current value is read for cross-member rules (null if the member is never a cross-member sibling).

member.description: Governed member name this binding addresses.
